statement: For every planar crystallographic group G, there exists A in GL(2,R) and an affine reflection group Wa such that A G A^-1 is a subgroup of Wa.
domain: All 17 affine-equivalence classes of planar crystallographic groups.
quantifiers: there exists an affine reflection supergroup Wa
finite_complete_domain_check: One representative point group from each of all 17 planar classes is checked against the paper-compatible reflection supergroup, with invertible distortion and recovery.
pass_condition: All 17 subgroup and conjugation-recovery checks pass; all destructive controls behave as intended.
failure_exit: The fixed verifier exits nonzero if any previously full-credit claim fails.
